content.title: Why is the walking lot at John Glenn Columbus closing?
content.text: TRANSPORTATIONThe walking lot at John Glenn Columbus will close in May, according to airport Nathan HartColumbus DispatchApril 13, 2026, 5:01 p.m. ET0:29/2:27Keep WatchingJohn Glenn Columbus International Airport's walking lot will close permanently May 4 to make way for a new public safety building, the Columbus Regional Airport Authority announced April 13.The public safety building is part of CMH Next, the airport authority's $2 billion project to build a new terminal for John Glenn Columbus.The walking lot, located at 4370 International Gateway, costs $16 to park per 24-hour period, according to the airport's website. Walking lot users can use the parking garage, the airport valet service or the shuttle lots once it closes, according to the airport authority.Transportation and neighborhoods reporter Nathan Hart can be reached at NHart@dispatch.com, at @NathanRHart on X and at nathanhart.dispatch.com on Bluesky.USA TODAY Shopping: Shop sales in tech, home, fashion, beauty & more curated by our editors.MD Refused Assisted Living For His Dad (This Is What He Did Instead)This doctor found what Japanese have always knownBesyner | AdAdUndoDermatologists Say This Drugstore Gem Is All You Need To Tighten WrinklesIt Targets the #1 Cause of Wrinkles People IgnoreThe Skin Magazine | AdAdUndoSciatica Is Not from a Slipped Disc.
